name: thread
description: One system that drives work through time — from attention to merged PRs. The continuity verbs answer 'what's my next move?' or decisively dispose of the current thread: open/resume durable state (thread:open), route when undecided (thread:next), orient on a whole project/area, reshuffle its open work into phases and tasks, and steer (thread:orient), lock a thread dormant (thread:stash), set it down onto a specific day (thread:defer), fork it to a fresh agent (thread:handoff), or finish and persist (thread:close). The rollout verbs drive rollout-shaped work through a convergence engine: thread:schedule orders tasks into a queue, thread:execute converges them (plan-gate -> verifier retry -> master review) and integrates each approved task with the latest main before it auto-merges, with thread:status and thread:repair for oversight and thread:retro to score a run and propose Tunings. One execution-fit test routes work between lanes.
